title: Let praise become the place you live
summary: The line refuses to let self-importance dress itself as honesty, intelligence, or force. Do not let the day outrun this: hold onto this: serve first, and let peace expose the self.
takeaway: Keep this close: Serve and let praise house the heart.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Peace deepens when praise, service, and Shabad replace self-importance.
source.lifeApplication: When ego reaches for the center, move into service and praise instead.
